title: Mod demography seeds
description: Content/demography/seeds.json: per-country demography seeds that replace (or add to) the shipped ones. A country's starting age pyramid is the shape of its row (scaled to its population), its life expectancy and fertility start from the row's le / tfr, and the calibration factors tune the monthly mortality and births. Give the shape as `cohorts` (101 headcounts per sex), as four `bands` shares, or inherit it from a `template` country; whatever is missing is inherited from the country's shipped row, its template, or the region template. A scenario nation that names a templateISO3 and has no row here inherits that template's row.

template.description: ISO3 of a shipped (or earlier mod) row to start from.

region.description: WorldRegion name whose template shape fills the gaps (default: the World template).

bands.description: Shares of youth (0-18), young (19-36), middle (37-56) and senior (57+); must sum to 1 (within 0.01).

cohorts.description: Headcounts by single year of age, 0 to 100. Only the shape matters (the pyramid is scaled to the country's population).

le.description: Life expectancy at birth in years; must lie inside the model's life-table grid.

tfr.description: Total fertility rate; must lie inside the model's fertility grid.

cbr_target.description: Calibration target: crude birth rate per mille.

cdr_target.description: Calibration target: crude death rate per mille.
